thesis: Fiscal Q4 crushed estimates (non-GAAP EPS $1.00 vs ~$0.75; sales $567M, +68% y/y vs ~$519M), and FY27 guidance calls for ~40% sales growth and $4.45 non-GAAP EPS with six new AI-infrastructure customers. Shares were up ~7% after hours, and analyst target hikes should land before the open.
main_risk: The after-hours gap fades as holders take profits after a 188% YTD run, or the call raises questions about gross margin or the $750M convert.

thesis: Q1 FY27 beat (adj. EPS $0.08 vs $0.05, 8.1% core growth, adj. EBITDA margin up to 18.7%) and FY revenue/EBITDA guidance was raised after a 7% drop today. The investor day at 9am ET Wednesday adds a second catalyst, and the stock was up ~10% after hours.
main_risk: Investor day long-term targets disappoint or the Petrifilm transition gets flagged as a risk, so the after-hours pop reverses.

thesis: Investor day set FY28 revenue at ~$20B and FY31 at $70-90B with $30+ EPS. Evercore lifted its target to $433 from $275, and more sell-side target raises should come out overnight and pull in buyers chasing the $300 breakout.
main_risk: RSI above 70 after a 239% YTD gain, so day-two 'sell the news' profit-taking could hit if analyst raises are already priced in.

thesis: A $4.2B DOE loan for nuclear uprates tied to Meta's AI load, plus the read-through from Constellation's Google deal, lifted VST ~11% on 14M+ shares and back above its 200-day. I expect analyst target hikes and follow-through buying toward the $170s.
main_risk: A one-day sector squeeze that mean-reverts, especially if yields rise again.

thesis: Google signed a 20-year, 3,590 MW deal (890 MW of new uprate capacity, $4.3B of investment), the second hyperscaler contract in a week after Amazon. The stock still sits about 28% below its 52-week high, so I expect target raises and continued re-rating on Wednesday.
main_risk: The +12% day already priced most of it, and the deal's pricing terms weren't disclosed.

thesis: Beat and raise: adj. EPS $0.75 vs $0.59, FY27 EPS guidance raised to $3.05-3.35, North America EBITDA +11%. The stock faded from a $50.19 intraday high to close at $47.91, so there's room for post-earnings drift as estimates move up.
main_risk: The international segment (EBITDA -54%) and staples-sector weakness cap the move.

thesis: Reports FQ1 after the close on Oct 7 (consensus revenue ~$125M, +94% y/y) with four straight double beats, about 21% short interest and the stock roughly 50% off its high. I'm holding through the print to catch a squeeze on new lease or Finland 1GW updates.
main_risk: A binary earnings gap down on wider losses, capex or financing (dilution) worries.

thesis: Marvell's investor day made the case that hyperscalers prefer custom ASICs. AVGO, the custom-silicon leader, rose ~4% in sympathy but still trades about 24% below its $495 high, with a consensus target around $503, leaving room for a multi-day re-rating.
main_risk: Megacap AI rotation stalls if yields push back above 5.3%.

thesis: Reports Q3 before the open Friday Oct 9 (EPS est ~$1.94). Crude is falling on G7 reserve releases, and Delta has guided that fare strength holds, so I'm positioning for a run-up and a beat with the stock 13% under its 52-week high.
main_risk: Q4 guide flags fuel or demand softness; oil rebounds on Middle East supply news.

thesis: Q3 earnings Oct 13 before the open falls inside a 5-session hold. Last quarter equities trading jumped 86%, and record-level markets plus heavy M&A this week (PTC $22.6B, OPCH $5.8B, RXO $5.8B) point to strong IB and markets fees, so I'm positioning for a pre-print run-up.
main_risk: Credit or NII guide disappoints with yields near 24-year highs; banks lag in a tech-led tape.

thesis: The core AI compute franchise, near a $6T market cap, at about 30x trailing P/E with a consensus target around $343. AMD's comment that compute demand is outrunning supply supports another strong print on Nov 25.
main_risk: AI capex digestion or concentration unwind; export restrictions.

thesis: About 17x earnings for search, YouTube, Cloud and TPU custom silicon, and it's locking in long-term clean power (Constellation deal) to scale AI. It trades ~15% under its 52-week high with a consensus target around $426.
main_risk: Antitrust remedies or AI search disruption to ad revenue.

thesis: Azure plus Copilot monetization and an enterprise moat, at about 29x P/E, just under its $553 high, with a consensus target around $568. Steady compounding into late-October earnings.
main_risk: Capex intensity weighs on margins; OpenAI relationship changes.

thesis: AWS AI demand plus retail margin expansion and advertising, at about 20x P/E and 11% below its $287 high, with a consensus target around $330. It has rare valuation support among AI megacaps.
main_risk: AWS share loss to Azure or Google Cloud; consumer slowdown with 5%+ yields.

thesis: The GLP-1 franchise leader (Zepbound/Mounjaro plus oral Foundayo, which showed a significant cardiovascular-risk reduction in Phase 3) with an expanding oncology label (Jaypirca first-line CLL approval). It held up while healthcare sold off and trades ~10% under its 52-week high.
main_risk: GLP-1 pricing pressure or Medicare negotiation headlines; sector-wide healthcare de-rating.
